Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _api_key = std.c.getenv("API_KEY") orelse return error.MissingApiKey;
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const result = try _client.speech("{\"input\":\"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\",\"model\":\"tts-1-hd\",\"response_format\":\"mp3\",\"speed\":1.0,\"voice\":\"nova\"}");
    std.debug.print("{any}\n", .{result});

}
```
